{{Top|leg}}
A '''freight hauler''' was a [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] vehicle designed to carry heavy payloads. It consisted of the hauler unit, which contained the operator cabin and the [[Power generator/Legends|power generator]], and a pull along, which could either be a flatbed or a container.
